               dang po sa 'tshaMs ni de ltar zhes bya ba <expan>la sogs</expan> pa ste | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> na re go rims si la pa <note type="editorial">Reading "si la pa" uncertain.</note> bzhin zhes pa'i don ni go cha ni sbyor laM | °°° ni mthong laM | °°° ni sgoM laM sa bdun pa man chad | nges par °°° pa ni khyad par gyi laM sa brgyad pa <lb edRef="inst:4513" n="76a8"/> yan chad do zhes sbyar nas | brgyad stong bar ni gzhan <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3756">thogs med</rs> kyi</note> lugs bshad pa yin pas mi 'gal lo zhes zer ro || 
               de ni ma yin te |</seg></TEI>
